verification.method: Reconstruct Git commit body from immutable GitHub Git-commit metadata and retain only the timezone/newline candidate whose Git commit-object SHA-1 exactly matches the published SHA. Raw bytes, not a tree-equivalent replacement, are provided.

native_import_contract: Require both original parents to exist, in the listed order. Import the original 726 ancestry from the separately verified canonical upstream packet first if needed.
Require the complete tree object b607ff5f50812c5e0f932d7dae18d4c74f1269cb produced by the native 53-path preparation to exist.
Decode raw_commit_base64 strictly; verify raw byte count, SHA256 and Git commit-object SHA-1 before writing with git hash-object -t commit -w --stdin.
Read back using git cat-file commit and require exact complete bytes. Do not reserialize dates, reorder parents, append a message newline, re-sign or create a substitute commit.
This package does not authorize ref updates or checkout changes; root controls final source refs and native controls the separately authorized exact-source execution.
